title: Canonicalize prompt bundles and create regression-triggering hooks for golden datasets
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Create a formalized workflow and platform primitives for producing immutable 'canonical' prompt bundles (golden datasets) that can be versioned, permissioned, and used as automatic regression gates tied to model/config changes. This ticket covers the product requirements and rollout plan: naming/metadata conventions, ACL model for owners/reviewers, snapshot immutability guarantees, an approval flow for promoting a bundle to 'golden', and wiring those bundles into CI/infra so model or config changes can trigger eval runs and block deployments on quality regression thresholds.
acceptance_criteria: A standardized prompt bundle manifest format is defined (metadata, provenance, tags, checksum) and documented
UI/CLI flow for creating a snapshoted bundle with an owner and reviewer group is specified
ACL semantics are defined: owner, reviewer, consumer; enforcement points listed for Console and Private deployments
A promotion workflow exists that marks a bundle as 'golden' with mandatory reviewer approval and immutable snapshotting
A webhook/CI contract is specified so infra can trigger eval runs when model versions or serving config change
Regression gating thresholds and failure modes are documented and mapped to rollout policies (canary block, alert-only, auto-rollback)
